answer.headline: Conversion rate dropped significantly beyond normal variation due to a checkout flow breakage primarily affecting Safari users.
explanation: Overall conversion rate dropped sharply from [F1] to [F2], moving far beyond typical weekly variation.
The primary driver was a steep decline in checkout start rates after adding items to the cart, specifically concentrated among Safari users starting from [F30].
While mobile and iOS segments also exhibited drops, the Safari segment showed the most severe and immediate divergence.
answer.next_step: Investigate the checkout start implementation and JavaScript errors specifically targeting Safari browsers following the December 21 release.
